v6.25.4.release_notes: URGENT root-cause fix for a live incident (16:50:30, a genuinely fresh M10 bar at closeAgeSeconds=30 was reported freshnessState=STALE, rejecting a valid BUY/TREND_PULLBACK candidate). Root cause: XAU_BuildM10EvidenceSnapshot() used td.continuationEntryPaused as a proxy for 'this bar's data is incomplete', but that field is actually !continuationEntryAllowed -- a real market-condition signal (true whenever exhaustion/transition readings currently disfavor a continuation-direction entry), completely unrelated to data availability. Any ordinary exhaustion/transition reading was forcing the entire M10 evidence snapshot to STALE regardless of how fresh the bar actually was. Fixed by separating freshness (bar identity only: evaluatedShift) from a new dataState axis (driven by a new evidenceDataUnavailable field, set true only in the two genuine fail-closed branches of XAU_AdaptiveMarketTransitionEngine() -- missing closed-bar/ATR/close price, or the bar being more than 2x the primary period old). STALE now always carries an explicit staleCause (NO_EVALUATED_BAR / BAR_MORE_THAN_ONE_CLOSED_M10_BEHIND / BAR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH). No approved trading behavior (risk, SL widening, timing, direction exclusivity, R-Exit, basket protection, exhaustion evidence-only, M10 primary authority) was altered -- this only fixes which readings are allowed to reach the unchanged decision logic.
